indication_en: Second-line or higher (2L+) advanced or metastatic GPC3+ hepatocellular carcinoma
sponsor_en: AstraZeneca AB / AstraZeneca Global R&D (China) Co., Ltd. / AstraZeneca Nijmegen B.V.
executive_summary:
**Candidate & Modality:** AZD9793 (Biologic / Large Molecule), developed by AstraZeneca AB / AstraZeneca Global R&D (China) Co., Ltd. / AstraZeneca Nijmegen B.V..

**Target Indication:** Investigated for Second-line or higher (2L+) advanced or metastatic GPC3+ hepatocellular carcinoma.

**Study Protocol & Design:** Phase I/II clinical evaluation enrolling an estimated 30-100 participants.

**Clinical Setting:** Conducted across accredited clinical research centers (Zhongshan Hospital, Fudan University) under China CDE supervision.
